abilities.name: Seize Command
abilities.description: When you spend Influence to gain 1 or more Command Tokens, you may place 1 other player’s Control Token in your tactic pool instead of gaining 1 of those Command Tokens. You can have only 1 of each player’s Control Tokens in your tactic pool.

abilities.name: Borrowed Authority
abilities.description: ACTION: Return 1 player’s Control Token from your tactic pool and perform a tactical action in a non-home, non–Mecatol Rex system with no other player’s units, using a token from that player’s reinforcements.

faction_techs.name: Overlord Matrix
faction_techs.description: When you activate a system or a system containing your units is activated you may exhaust this card to treat 1 of your units as galvanized during this tactical action for each command token in your tactic pool.

faction_techs.name: Cognitive Parallax Engine
faction_techs.description: When you would spend a Command Token from your strategy pool, you may exhaust this card to instead spend a Command Token from your reinforcements.

agents.name: Viren Tolar - Shadowstealer
agents.description: At the end of a player’s turn, you may exhaust this card. That player may spend 1 Influence to gain 1 Command Token.

commanders.name: Serisi Sithis - High Marshal
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have your command tokens in 4 different systems.]
commanders.description: When you gain 1 or more Command Tokens, gain 1 Commodity for each Command Token gained.

heroes.name: Ellar Liser - Impetus of Control
heroes.note: Echo of Subjugation - Harbinger of Chains
heroes.description: ACTION: Choose up to 1 command token bleonging tp each player on the game board. Return those tokens to their owners reinforcements; for each token removed this way, gain 1 Command Token and 1 Trade Good. Then purge this card.

promissory.name: The Usurper's Lease
promissory.description: When you would spend Influence to gain 1 or more Command Tokens. Increase the amount of Influence spent by the number of neighbors you have. Then, return this card to the Ardentia player.

flagship.name: Sovereign's Gavel
flagship.description: After you roll dice for a round of combat, you may spend 1 Command Token from your strategy pool to produce 2 additional hits.

mech.name: Iron Claw Division
mech.description: DEPLOY: During the Commit Ground Forces step in a system adjacent to or containing a planet you control, you may spend 3 Influence to commit 1 Mech from your reinforcements.

starting_fleet.name: Ardentia Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 2 Fighters, 4 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Subjugate
breakthrough.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 3 influence to return 1 other player's command token from the game board to their reinforcements. Then, perform a tactical action in a non-home system without spending a command token.

abilities.name: Diplomatic Immunity
abilities.description: You do not have to spend a Command Token to resolve the secondary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card. Other players cannot place your command tokens when resolving the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

abilities.name: Mandate of Presence
abilities.description: When you pass, you may spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to perform the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

faction_techs.name: Bilateral Nexus
faction_techs.description: When you resolve the primary ability of a strategy card, you may exhaust this card to resolve the secondary ability of that strategy card without spending a Command Token.

faction_techs.name: Domestic Production Agreements
faction_techs.description: You may treat command tokens in systems that contain your ships as units with PRODUCTION 1.

agents.name: Seris Kael - Warden of Accord
agents.description: When another player returns a promissory note to its owner for its effect, you may exhaust this card; those players each gain 1 command token.

commanders.name: Velorine Nevorith - Keeper of Keys
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have ships in a system that contains 2 or more other players' command tokens.]
commanders.description: Increase the influence and resource values of planets you control in systems that contain command tokens by 1.

heroes.name: Aranth Vel - The Everbinding
heroes.note: Pact Sunt Servanda - For the Greater Good
heroes.description: ACTION: For each other player, place 1 Command Token in a system that contains 1 or more of your units and no other player’s Command Tokens. Then, purge this card.

promissory.name: Pact Renewed
promissory.description: When you resolve the primary ability of a strategy card, you may place this card face up in your play area. Resolve the secondary ability of that strategy card without spending a command token. At the start of the Status Phase, return this card to the Verydith player.

flagship.name: Concordia's Voice
flagship.description: Non-fighter ships in this system roll 1 additional die during combat if this system contains another player’s Command Token.

mech.name: Pactforged Sentinel
mech.description: Other players must spend 1 Influence or destroy 1 unit they control to return a Command Token from a system that contains 1 or more of this unit to their reinforcements.

starting_fleet.name: Verydith Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Dreadnought, 3 Fighters, 3 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Unyielding Accord
breakthrough.description: When 1 or more other players place a command token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control, ready 1 planet in that system and explore it. ACTION: Exhaust this card and select 1 player who has passed. That player places 1 of their command tokens in a system that contains your units and none of their command tokens.

abilities.name: Lobbyist Dues
abilities.description: When an agenda resolves, if the outcome that you voted for or predicted was not resolved, gain commodities equal to the number of players who voted for the outcome that was resolved.

abilities.name: Tight Scheduling
abilities.description: After the first agenda is revealed during the agenda phase, draw 3 cards from the agenda deck and place them in your hand. When an agenda would be revealed, you may reveal 1 agenda from your hand instead. At the end of the agenda phase, place the remaining agendas on the bottom of the agenda deck in any order.

faction_techs.name: Kleptocratic Politics
faction_techs.description: After an agenda is revealed, you may exhaust this card and predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, perform the secondary ability of a strategy card without spending a command token. If that agenda is resolved with no effect, ready this card.

faction_techs.name: Inner Sanctum
faction_techs.description:
Gain the Inner Sanctum planet card and its legendary planet ability card. You cannot lose these cards, and this card cannot have an X or Y assimilator token placed on it.

Inner Sanctum — 0 Resources / 3 Influence

After an agenda is revealed, you may exhaust this card and predict aloud the outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, each player who voted for the resolved outcome draws 1 action card.

agents.name: Orrin Malvek - Deacon of Taxes and Prayer
agents.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card. Draw 1 action card and look at the top agenda. Place that card on the top or bottom of the agenda deck.

commanders.name: Cyrala Vey - Bishop of Law and Scripture
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: At the start of the agenda phase, exhaust all but 3 planets you control.]
commanders.description: After an agenda is resolved: If an outcome you voted for is not resolved, produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 of your ships with a cost up to the number of votes you cast.

heroes.name: Speaker Gilbrand - Cardinal of Governance and Faith
heroes.note: Adoration of the Masses - Thousandfold Council
heroes.description: ACTION: Select up to 2 agendas in the discard pile. Immediately vote on those agendas in any order as if you were the speaker. During each of those agendas you may purge 1 “Rider” action card from the discard pile to use its effect as if it were in your hand. Then, purge this card.

promissory.name: Hand of the Synod
promissory.description: ACTION: Discard up to 1 action card. Then, draw 1 more action cards than you discarded. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Veylor player.

flagship.name: Silent Edict
flagship.description: When this unit produces 1 or more hits, you may discard any number of action cards to assign that many of those hits to an opponent's ship in this system.

mech.name: Vox Sentinels
mech.description: When you exhaust this unit’s planet to vote, cast 2 additional votes.

starting_fleet.name: Velyor Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 2 Carriers, 1 Cruiser, 3 Fighters, 3 Infantry, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Filibustered Legislation
breakthrough.description: When an agenda is resolved, you may exhaust this card. That agenda is resolved with no effect. Each player may ready 1 planet they control. Vote on 1 additional agenda during the Agenda Phase this effect is used.

abilities.name: Factory Lease
abilities.description: During setup, gain the Factory Lease promissory notes. At the start of the Agenda Phase: You may produce 1 unit with a cost of 4 or less in systems containing 1 of your space docks and no other players' ships up to the number of Factory Lease attachments on the game board.

abilities.name: Echo of the Anvil
abilities.description: When you produce 2 or more non-fighter ships of the same type, gain 1 trade good.

faction_techs.name: Replicator I
faction_techs.description: This unit can only produce units of the same type as those that are in the space area of its system.

faction_techs.name: Replicator II
faction_techs.description: This unit cannot be destroyed by "Direct Hit" action cards. This unit can only produce units of the same type as those in its system.

faction_techs.name: Segmented Structuring
faction_techs.description: At any time, you may exhaust this card and remove 1 of your ships from the game board. Place non-fighter ships of the same type in that unit's system with a combined cost equal to or less than that unit's cost.

agents.name: Kelron Dross - Ember-Sword
agents.description: When a player moves ships into a system, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to destroy 1 non-fighter ship with a cost equal to or less than 4 on the game board. That system gains PRODUCTION equal to that unit's cost + 2.

commanders.name: Thessa Scale - Ash-Plate
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 4 or more non-fighter ships of the same type in the same system.]
commanders.description: Twice per action, when you place a PDS or Space Dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control: Draw 2 Action Cards, then discard 1.

heroes.name: Orun Slag - The Eternal Forge-Hammer
heroes.note: Sledge of the Master - Factory World Mass Production
heroes.description: ACTION: Remove any number of your units from the game board and place them in systems that contain a planet you control and no other player’s ships. Then purge this card.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Cultural
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a cultural planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its influence value.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Hazardous
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to a hazardous planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to its resource value.

promissory.name: Factory Lease: Industrial
promissory.description: At the end of your turn, attach this card to an industrial planet you control. That planet gains PRODUCTION equal to the number of planets in this system +1.

flagship.name: Hammer of Silence
flagship.description: This unit’s PRODUCTION equals the resource value of 1 planet you control in this unit’s system.

mech.name: Ironbound Guardian
mech.description: DEPLOY: After movement, you may remove 2 of your Fighters or Infantry from the active system to place 1 Mech from reinforcements with your units in the active system.

starting_fleet.name: Myrr Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Cruiser, 2 Dreadnoughts, 5 Fighters, 3 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Remote Workforce
breakthrough.description: When you resolve a unit's PRODUCTION ability, you may exhaust this card to resolve the PRODUCTION abilities of each unit you control in another system. Increase the combined PRODUCTION of those units by 2.

abilities.name: Shared Discoveries
abilities.description: At the end of a player's tactical action in a non-home system: You may spend 1 commodity to allow that player to explore a planet in the active system as if it had any planet trait.

abilities.name: Colony Outposts
abilities.description: At the end of a tactical action during which you explored a planet: You may spend 1 command token to reveal cards from that planet's exploration deck until you reveal an attachment. Resolve that exploration and shuffle the other revealed cards back into the deck.

flagship.name: Vaultbreaker
flagship.description: When you gain control of a planet in this unit's system, gain 1 Commodity.

mech.name: Excavator
mech.description: Once per action, at the end of a tactical action, if a planet in the active system contains exactly 2 of your Mechs, you may explore that planet.

faction_techs.name: Surveyor's Lens
faction_techs.description: Once per action, at the end of a tactical action, you may exhaust this card to explore 1 planet you control in the active system. When you gain a relic fragment during exploration, you may remove 1 infantry from the explored planet to ready this card.

faction_techs.name: Trait Harmonizer
faction_techs.description: Increase your commodity value by 1 for each different planet trait among non-home planets you control.

promissory.name: Archaeologist Outpost
promissory.description: ACTION: Attach this card to 1 non-home planet. When a player activates this planet's system, explore this planet.

agents.name: Draven Callas - Rummager of Relics
agents.description: When a player explores a planet they control. You may exhaust this card to allow that player to draw 3 exploration cards, choose 1 to resolve, and shuffle the rest back into the deck.

commanders.name: Seral Venn - Bounding Cartographer
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 2 cards from different exploration decks in your play area.]
commanders.description: At the start of the Strategy Phase, choose 1 non-home, non-legendary planet. Explore that planet as if it were any trait.

heroes.name: Zairos CVI - Explorer Extraordinaire
heroes.description: ACTION: Shuffle 5 purged exploration cards that do not place tokens on the game board on top of their respective exploration decks. Then explore up to 5 planets you control. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Kairn Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 2 Dreadnoughts, 2 Fighters, 2 Infantry, 2 Mechs, 2 Space Docks

breakthrough.name: Relic Trading Hub
breakthrough.description: When you gain this breakthrough and at the start of each strategy phase, shuffle each relic on this card back into the relic deck. Then, draw 3 relics and place them on this card. After a player gains a relic, you may exhaust this card to purge that relic and give that player 1 relic on this card.

abilities.name: Evolved Warforms
abilities.description: Your mechs are treated as both ships and ground forces and have a move value of 1. Mechs that are not being transported count against your fleet pool.

abilities.name: Testing Yard
abilities.description: One ship of each type in your home system does not count against fleet capacity.

faction_techs.name: Ultimate Evolution II
faction_techs.description: When you would research a technology, you may flip this card instead.

faction_techs.name: Ultimate Evolution III
faction_techs.description: When this unit uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE, cancel an additional hit.

faction_techs.name: Warspawn Juggernaut II
faction_techs.description: When you would research a technology, you may flip this card instead.

faction_techs.name: Warspawn Juggernaut III
faction_techs.description: When this unit produces 1 or more hits, you may damage it to place up to that many infantry from your reinforcements with this unit.

promissory.name: Evolutionary Edict
promissory.description: When you research a unit upgrade, produce 1 of those units in your home system. Reduce its cost by the number of its prerequisites. At the start of the Kryxos player's turn, return this card to the Kryxos player.

agents.name: Dravok Veyl - Warshaper
agents.description: ACTION: Select 1 player and exhaust this card. That player may return 1 technology they own to research 1 unit upgrade technology.

commanders.name: Seraxis Thule - Battle Genealogist
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Own 2 unit upgrade technologies.]
commanders.description: Apply +1 to the combat rolls and unit ability rolls of your units for which you own the corresponding unit upgrade technology.

heroes.name: Zorath Ultimus - Evolution Incarnate
heroes.description: ACTION: Select 1 unit upgrade technology you own. For each prerequisite on it, research 1 technology of that color. Then, purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Kryxos Starting Fleeet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Dreadnought, 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 1 Mech, 1 Fighter, 1 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Prototype Innovators
breakthrough.description: During each round of combat, or when you would roll dice for a unit ability, you may treat up to 3 units you control that own the unit upgrade technology as if they were galvanized.

abilities.name: Ritual of Ascension
abilities.description: ACTION: Purge 2 relic fragments to research 1 technology.

abilities.name: Primordial Secrets
abilities.description: During setup, choose 1 primordial technology to use during this game. You have 1 additional faction technology.

abilities.name: Forbidden Knowledge
abilities.description: You cannot gain a primordial technology unless you own 4 technologies of its color, ignoring synergies. Other players cannot use the abilities of primordial technologies.

flagship.name: The Astral Codex
flagship.description: At the start of combat in this system, select 1 color of technology. This unit rolls additional combat dice equal to the number of technologies you own in that color.

mech.name: Rune-Bound Sentinel
mech.description: When you research a technology you may damage this unit to ignore any 1 prerequisite on that technology.

faction_techs.name: Sigil of Transmutation
faction_techs.description: This technology may be treated as either a warfare or cybernetic technology. When you move ships into a non-home system, you may exhaust this card to give that system SPACE CANNON 5 (x3) and PRODUCTION 3 as if it were a unit until the end of that tactical action.

faction_techs.name: Seal of Revelation
faction_techs.description: This technology may be treated as either a biotic or propulsion technology. ACTION: Exhaust this card to shuffle up to 1 purged exploration card that does not place a token on the game board into its respective exploration deck. Then, explore a planet you control.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Disintegrate
faction_techs.description: At the start of each round of combat involving your units, you may produce 1 hit against your opponent's units. Then, you may exhaust this card to destroy 1 unit participating in that combat.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Miracle
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to gain 1 command token in your tactic pool, draw 1 action card, and place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on a planet you control.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Plane Shift
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to perform a tactical action in a system that contains no planets without placing a command token. Ignore the effects of anomalies during this tactical action.

faction_techs.name: Power Word: Fabricate
faction_techs.description: Gain the Fabricate Station planet card and its legendary planet ability card, and ready them. You cannot lose these cards.

promissory.name: Scroll of Ascension
promissory.description: At the start of the strategy phase, research 1 non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology. Then, the Arcanum player may spend 1 command token from their strategy pool to gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Arcanum player.

agents.name: Veyla Biphos - Keeper of Tomes
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to return 1 of their non-faction, non-unit upgrade technologies to research 1 technology of a different color.

commanders.name: Orthis Lithon - Rune-Smith
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Own 1 technology in 2 different colors.]
commanders.description: When you purge 2 or more relic fragments to resolve an ability, you may purge 1 technology you own as if it were a relic fragment of any type.

heroes.name: Xirath Centious - The Eternal Sage
heroes.description: ACTION: Gain 2 purged relic fragments and research 2 technologies. Then, purge this card.

starting_techs.name: Arcanum Starting Tech
starting_techs.note: Choose 2 technologies in the same color with no prerequisites

starting_fleet.name: Arcanum Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 2 Destroyers, 3 Fighters, 4 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

breakthrough.name: Power Word: Wish
breakthrough.description: When you gain this breakthrough, choose a side for it to start on. When you research a propulsion or warfare technology, flip this card. When you activate a system, you may apply +1 to the move value of 1 unit you control and +2 to the combat value of 2 units you control during that tactical action.

other.name: Power Word: Wish
other.description:
Synergy: Yellow<>Green

When you research a cybernetic or biotic technology, flip this card. When you activate a system, apply +1 to the capacity value of 2 units until the end of that tactical action. When you use PRODUCTION, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

abilities.name: Sting of the Hive
abilities.description: When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability, you may cancel any number of those hits to place or move that many mine tokens into that system.

abilities.name: Hive Echo
abilities.description: When you would use SPACE CANNON, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, or BOMBARDMENT (except during SPACE CANNON DEFENSE) in a system containing your ships, a unit with that unit ability up to 2 systems away may use it as if it were in the active system.

flagship.name: Queen's Fang
flagship.description: This unit rolls extra combat and unit ability dice equal to the number of ground forces it is transporting.

mech.name: Hexan Stingers
mech.description: DEPLOY: After a player moves ships into a system containing a planet you control, you may spend 2 trade goods to place 1 mech from your reinforcements on a planet you control in that system.

faction_techs.name: Biomechanical Nutrients
faction_techs.description: When you produce two or more hits with a unit ability you may produce 1 ship in a system that contains your ships with a cost less than the number of hits produced.

promissory.name: Royal Blessing
promissory.description: When you roll dice for a unit ability, apply +2 to the results of those rolls. Then, return this card to the Xytheris player.

agents.name: Myrix Nevom - The Wax-Sealed
agents.description: When a player activates a system, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to choose 1 ship. That ship gains capacity and PRODUCTION values equal to the number of different unit abilities it has during that tactical action. If it already has either of those values, increase that value by that amount instead.

commanders.name: Zythrix Isopon - Leader of the Endless Swarm
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Produce 3 or more hits with a unit ability.]
commanders.description: When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability, produce 1 additional hit.

heroes.name: Xyra Xotin - The Venom-Queen
heroes.note: Call of the Queen - The Endless Swarm.
heroes.description: ACTION: Place this card near the game board. Once per action, when you would roll dice for a unit ability, apply +4 to the results of those rolls. Purge this card at the end of the game round.

starting_fleet.name: Xytheris Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 1 Cruiser, 1 Destroyer, 6 Infantry, 1 Space Dock, 2 PDS

breakthrough.name: Royal Rail Gun
breakthrough.description: If you own a PDS Unit Upgrade Technology flip this card over and place it in your play area. Your PDS units gain the following ability text and adjust their printed values by the indicated amounts. If they do not have those values, they gain them. Back Side Effect: This unit is also a ground force and a ship and may be transported in a ship with capacity. Stats: Combat 5, Planetary Shield, Sustain Damage.

abilities.name: Ignorant Discoveries
abilities.description: At the start of the status phase, you may purge 1 technology and spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to research 2 technologies.

abilities.name: Reflections of the Void
abilities.description: When you move ships into a system with no planets, you may place 1 reflection token in a system that contains a planet you control. You may treat reflection tokens as frontier tokens for all purposes. When a reflection token would be removed from the game board, purge it instead.

flagship.name: The Obsidian Mirror
flagship.description: You may treat this ship as adjacent to all systems that contain no planets.

mech.name: Acolyte of the Hollow
mech.description: During the Action Phase, if you purge 1 or more components, place 1 Infantry with this unit.

faction_techs.name: Oblivion Cannon
faction_techs.description: At the end of a round of space combat, you may purge 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system. Produce and assign hits equal to half its cost, rounded up, against your opponent's units in that system.

faction_techs.name: Mirrored Memories
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Play 1 action card with a component action from the discard pile and exhaust this card. Purge that action card instead of discarding it.

promissory.name: Oblivion Genesis
promissory.description: ACTION: Draw 3 unused red-backed system tiles. Choose 1 and purge the others. Place that tile on the edge of the game board, adjacent to 2 systems, and place a frontier token in that system if it contains no planets. Then, purge this card.

agents.name: Avaris the Seer - Keeper of Silence
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card to place 1 frontier token in a system that contains no planets. Then, look at the top card of the frontier deck. Place it on top of that deck or discard it.

commanders.name: Deyra the Voidborn
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have units in 3 systems adjacent to a system that contains no planets.]
commanders.description: When you purge 1 or more components, you may produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 of your ships.

heroes.name: Frontiersman Nothi - The Mouth of the Abyss
heroes.description: ACTION: Draw 2 unused red-backed tiles and 2 unused blue-backed tiles. Choose 1 of each and purge the others. Place those tiles on the edge of the game board adjacent to 2 systems and a frontier token in each system that contains no planets. Then purge this card.

starting_fleet.name: Oblivion Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 2 Carriers, 1 Destroyer, 2 Fighter, 2 Infantry, 2 Mechs, 1 Space Dock

breakthrough.name: Cosmic Manifestations
breakthrough.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card and select a system adjacent to your home system that contains no planets. Replace that system tile with a randomly drawn red-backed tile. Purge that replaced tile. If the new system contains no planets, place a frontier token in it.

abilities.name: Call of the Haunted
abilities.description: During setup, purge your alliance promissory note and 1 Revenant Pantheon card. Then, gain each of the leaders listed on that card. You have 1 additional leader of each type.

abilities.name: Commanding Presence
abilities.description: When you unlock a leader or purge a leader to resolve its ability, gain 1 command token.

abilities.name: Allure of Darkness
abilities.description: At the start of the Strategy Phase: Choose 1 other player's commander that does not have the lich token on it and place the lich token on it.

flagship.name: Reliquary Eternal
flagship.description: This unit rolls a number of additional dice equal to the number of unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged leader types in your play area.

mech.name: Grave Robbers
mech.description: DEPLOY: When you exhaust an agent to resolve its ability, you may damage this unit to place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on this unit's planet.

faction_techs.name: Lazarus Pods
faction_techs.description: When you exhaust an agent to resolve its ability, you may produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 of your ships. When you purge a hero to resolve its ability, you may produce 2 units in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.

faction_techs.name: Eternal Aegis
faction_techs.description: During the first round of combat, you may cancel a number of hits equal to the number of leader types you have unlocked, unexhausted, and unpurged.

promissory.name: Revenant Rebirth
promissory.description: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area, purge 1 random unused Revenant Pantheon card, and gain the agent listed on that card. At the start of the status phase, return this card to the Revenant player.

agents.name: Xythis the Whispering Mask - The Gravetender Eternal
agents.description: Once per action, when a player exhausts a technology, you may exhaust this card to ready that technology.

agents.name: Necrolith - Revenant of Stratum
agents.description: When a player explores a planet they control: You may exhaust this card to allow that player to explore that planet as if it had any planet trait. If you choose another player, draw 1 Action Card.

agents.name: Lothos Yvollus - Revenant of the Arcanum
agents.description: When a player passes, you may exhaust this card. That player returns 1 non-unit upgrade, non-faction technology with 1 or more prerequisites. Then, they may research 1 technology with exactly 1 fewer prerequisite.

agents.name: Koral Vel - Revenant of Verydith
agents.description: When a player would spend a command token or place a command token on the game board, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to place or spend a command token from their reinforcements instead, if able.

agents.name: Kruth Torrious - Revenant of Ardentia
agents.description: When another player places a command token into a system, you may exhaust this card to move that command token to a non-home system that contains your units and no legendary planets.

agents.name: Thrash Feral Burner - Revenant of Scrapyard
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, you may exhaust this card to allow that player to produce 1 unit in a system that contains 1 or more of their ships.

commanders.name: Ashara of the Silent Choir - Duke of the Necromancer
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: 2 other players have unlocked commanders.]
commanders.description: While the lich token is on an unlocked commander, you may use that commander's ability.

commanders.name: Melloh Terras - Revenant of Ponthous
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 3 units with SUSTAIN DAMAGE on the game board.]
commanders.description: Once per action, when you produce units, you may produce 1 additional infantry or fighter for its cost. That additional unit does not count against your PRODUCTION limit.

commanders.name: Arlir Mirrored - Revenant of Oblivion
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Control a planet of each planet trait.]
commanders.description: When you explore a planet that contains 1 of your structures, you may draw 1 additional exploration card. Choose 1 to resolve and discard the rest.

commanders.name: Zexan Mythis - Revenant of Xytheris
commanders.note: [UNLOCK: Have 5 units with different unit abilities on the game board.]

other.description: When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, discard any number of Action Cards. Apply +2 to the total PRODUCTION value of your units and reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1 for each Action Card discarded. Then, shuffle this card into the Hydromorphic deck.

other.name: Tidal Influence
other.description: When an agenda is revealed, discard 1 Action Card; choose another player. That player must give you 1 Promissory Note from their hand. Then, shuffle this card into the Hydromorphic deck.

other.name: Tidal Bounty
other.description: ACTION: Discard any number of Action Cards; place 1 neutral unit in a non-home system that contains no non-neutral ships with a cost up to the number of Action Cards discarded. Then, shuffle this card into the Hydromorphic deck.

other.name: Charted Currents
other.description: ACTION: Discard 3 Action Cards. Perform the secondary ability of any readied or unchosen strategy card without spending a command token. Then, shuffle this card into the Hydromorphic deck.

breakthrough.name: Metamorphic Transference
breakthrough.description: When you negotiate a transaction, action cards in either player's hand or on this card may be exchanged as part of that transaction. When you win a combat, place the top card of the action card deck face up on this card.

abilities.name: Radiant Grafting
abilities.description: When your units enter into coexistence on a planet, Choose 1 Radiant Grafting ability card to gain and place it face up in your play area. At any time you have more Radiant Grafting ability cards than there are planets that have your coexisting units, remove Radiant Grafting ability cards until you do not.

abilities.name: Celestial Envoys
abilities.description: Once during each of your strategic actions, when a player resolves the secondary ability of your strategy card, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements into coexistence on a non-home planet that contains that player's ground forces.

faction_techs.name: Restructuring
faction_techs.description: ACTION: Exhaust this card to remove up to 3 of your structures from the game board and place them on 1 or more planets you control.

faction_techs.name: Mutualism
faction_techs.description: You may use the PRODUCTION, SPACE CANNON, or PLANETARY SHIELD abilities of structures with which your units are coexisting. ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose 1 other player. That player may place 1 structure from their reinforcements into coexistence on a planet you control. If they do, they gain 1 command token.

agents.name: The Hope of the Cosmos
agents.description: At the start of a player's turn, exhaust this card and choose 1 other player. Each of those players may move 1 infantry from a planet they control into coexistence on a non-home planet controlled by the other player that contains that other player's ground forces.

commanders.name: Mending Light
commanders.note: UNLOCK: Have structures on 2 planets outside of your home system.
commanders.description: When a player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your structures and no other player's ships, place 1 fighter from your reinforcements in that system for each of those structures.

heroes.name: Eternal Provider
heroes.description: ACTION: You may allow each other player to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of their units, reducing the combined cost of the units they produce by 4. Then, place any number of units from your reinforcements in systems that contain your ships with a combined cost equal to or less than the combined cost of those produced units. Then, purge this card.

mech.name: Commensalists
mech.description: Your mechs have the ability text of the mechs of each player with whom your units are coexisting.

flagship.name: Double Dragons
flagship.description: DEPLOY: At any time, you may remove 2 structures from a planet you control in a system that contains your ships to place this unit from your reinforcements in that system.

starting_fleet.name: Thurviali Starting Fleet
starting_fleet.description: 1 Carrier, 2 Cruisers, 4 Fighters, 3 Infantry, 1 Mech, 1 Space Dock, 1 PDS

starting_techs.name: Thurviali Starting Tech
starting_techs.note: During setup, gain each of another player's starting technologies.

promissory.name: Radiant Assembly
promissory.description: ACTION: Place this card face up in your play area and place 1 structure from your reinforcements on a planet you control. Return this card to the Thurviali player at the end of the status phase.

breakthrough.name: Neurografting
breakthrough.description: When your units enter coexistence with another player's units, you may exhaust this card to research 1 technology owned by that player. When another player ends coexistence with your units, you may ready this card.

other.name: Radiant Grafting: Claws
other.description: Your structures are treated as ground forces and gain a combat value of 6 if they do not already have a combat value. They participate in combats where they are located. Your structures cannot be transported.

other.name: Radiant Grafting: Scales
other.description: Your structures gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE if they do not have it. Your structures may use their SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability to cancel a hit that is produced against your ships in their system or ground forces on their planet.

other.name: Radiant Grafting: Parturition
other.description: Your PDS units and space docks gain a cost of 4 and may be produced by your units with PRODUCTION. Place those structures on any planets you control in the producing unit's system.

other.name: Radiant Grafting: Phalanges
other.description: Your mechs gain PRODUCTION 1 and SPACE CANNON 9 and are treated as structures for all purposes.

other.name: Radiant Grafting: Flight
other.description: Your structures are also ships with a move value of 1 and count against your fleet pool. They cannot use unit abilities while in a space area. At the end of your tactical actions, you may place your structures that are in space areas on planets you control in their respective systems. Blockaded structures in the space area of a system are destroyed.
